title: WS9 row S01 (normal tool loop) vs our llm-proxy — flagship seat gpt-5.6-sol (responses wire, strict_responses_input=true, live defaults). Two headless turns in one resumed session: baseline turn (WS9-S01-T1), then the tool-loop turn — TWO real run_terminal_command round-trips (echo nonces, write-free) followed by the exact terminal reply (WS9-S01-T2). Verdict semantics (discriminating-pin design, T21 house pattern): the harness premise is the control pin sh_call (escaped tool-arguments form — the tools[] schema and the prompt text cannot false-satisfy it): 0-hit => VACUOUS (the model never took the tool path — temperament, recorded, not a defect); with the premise held, the scored pins decide PASS/FAIL — the synthesized payload pins (the nonces must appear in the request tool-result payloads) + the ndjson pins (the model QUOTES the nonce output in its reply — container-agnostic payload proof). A 400 on a tool round-trip is NOT recovered-by-design on the strict sol row: it FAILs as a tool-path finding (strict-mode schema rejection is the point of the ship-gate row). Semantic-diff dimensions (semantics-not-bytes per recon-plan L130-131: family tool schemas intentionally differ): (1) tool invoked with declared args (name+args semantics, escaped-JSON pin), (2) result payload reached the model (nonce quoted in the reply), (3) loop closed (final text), (4) usage-field consistency + reasoning visibility = stream-fidelity baseline (recon records; cross-ref wstream cell ws9-s01-toolloop-sol for the SSE-frame view). No PROP gate (pure fidelity row); BRICK = S3 report-and-stop.

steps.prompt: Perform exactly these two tool calls, in this order, using the run_terminal_command tool, and no other tools: (1) echo WS9-S01-ECHO-A (2) echo WS9-S01-ECHO-B. After both results return, reply with exactly: ECHOED:WS9-S01-ECHO-A WS9-S01-ECHO-B WS9-S01-T2

ndjson.label: LOOP CLOSED: the tool-loop turn completed with the exact terminal nonce.

PAYLOAD PROOF (container-agnostic): the reply quotes both echo outputs — the tool RESULTS reached the model's context (the prompt names the commands, so only a real round-trip can make the model quote the output).

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): an escaped tool-arguments line (the form ONLY a real tool call carries — the tools[] schema and the prompt text cannot false-satisfy it) marks the declared echo command actually issued. 0-hit = the model never took the tool path (VACUOUS, temperament).

STREAM-FIDELITY BASELINE RECORD (S01 / JIG L3): records how many captured request lines carry reasoning INPUT items on the strict sol seat (stream-fidelity-per-wire baseline; the SSE-frame view is the wstream ws9-s01-toolloop-sol cell). recon — always records, never fails.
VERDICT RECORD: merged ndjson final text head (the loop's terminal output, verbatim). recon — always records, never fails.
